highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews the Graphite GPU backend and expands Vulkan support, built on Skia m152.
highlights_body: Adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, and backend-neutral async pixel readback, alongside several native memory-leak and performance fixes.

bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine to Chrome milestone m152, folding in the upstream m151 stability fixes merged along the way.
Adds Graphite bindings for the Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn backends, giving consumers an early path onto Skia's next-generation GPU backend.
Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and runs the Vulkan test suite on Android and Linux, broadening supported Vulkan interop options.
Adds an async RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface that works consistently across GPU backends.
Fixes use-after-free bugs in SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* by rooting the owning native object for the lifetime of the derived object.

bullets.lead: CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on raster failure
bullets.detail: Fixes a leaked CoTaskMem pixel buffer when SKImage.Create fails to build a raster image.

bullets.lead: Nano Server font support via FreeType
bullets.detail: Uses FreeType for font rendering on Nano Server, where the platform font manager is unavailable.
Adds containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server, and initializes the MSVC environment once per native Windows build.

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opens the 4.152.0 line, updating Skia to m152, adding the Graphite GPU backend bindings, the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, backend-neutral async pixel readback, and several native memory-leak and performance fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz binding to 14.2.1, syncing it with the m152 Skia update and converting its solution to .slnx format.
